payload.title: Reconcile preserved experiment-pipeline ownership and conflicting B-0048 before main integration
payload.summary: P2 bounded integration decision after the current whole-feature candidate. feat/experiment-execution-pipeline-prepare at2aad8a1c adds three divergent commits, src/devtools/orchestration/experiments target-process preparation/execution/receipt contracts and controller budget/dispatch changes. Its branch-local B-0048-experiment-pipeline-authorized-execution collides with canonical B-0048-restore-python-3-12-json-file-model-compatibility. Current architecture reserves orchestration while the preserved branch proposes a reusable framework owner. The completed engineering claim and unfinished frozen scientific deployment must be evaluated separately; neither multi-commit history nor lack of a scientific result alone makes the code unmergeable.
payload.benefit: Owner: repository maintainer/Orchestration and scientific-controller maintainers. Review the exact three-commit delta and decide the existing concrete pipeline ownership without creating another Integration subsystem. Reconcile the branch-local backlog ID through canonical Intake authority; never overwrite or renumber the canonical JSON item or frozen historical record. Acceptance: explicit framework-versus-experiment decision; exact target/controller/budget/receipt schema closure; authored one-checkout synthetic fixtures with no Devtools copies or live science; exact destination-based code candidate preserving Commands and current worker; strict static checks and fresh100% protected production gate if source is adopted. Scientific execution, fresh target bindings and grants remain separate. If intentionally retired, preserve exact branch/evidence identities and record why no unique maintained capability is lost.
payload.uncertainty: Source/read-only tip review only, not a new full semantic audit of this non-RI domain or fresh validation of the preserved pipeline. Existing package uses managed Commands and separate target-owned imports; this is not asserted to be a live worker vulnerability or an automatic dependency-direction violation. Existing B-0038/B-0044 are broad pressure but lack this exact branch/ID/acceptance obligation. Suitable bounded maintainer decision followed by specialized maintenance implementation after approval.
